meta.name: business-intelligence
meta.description: Builds reporting and self-serve analytics that people actually use — metric trees, dashboard design, distribution, and the discipline that stops dashboards proliferating. Use this to build a dashboard or report, design a metrics framework, set up self-serve analytics, decide what to measure, or diagnose why reporting exists but nobody uses it or trusts it.

copy.tagline: 打造真正被团队使用的数据看板与指标体系
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果报表很多但没人看,想建起团队真正在用的分析体系。
copy.tagline_en: Build dashboards and metrics frameworks people actually use.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team has dashboards nobody uses and you want metrics people trust.

howto.what: Claude会先问这份报表给谁看、支撑什么决策;没有决策就不建。指标按“结果在上、驱动因素在下”的树来拆。做仪表盘时,它要求一屏只答一个问题、数字带对比并写明“好”的标准,异常要加解释,没人用的看板要停用。
howto.when: 当你说要搭报表/仪表盘或自助分析、设计指标框架,或诊断报表为何没人用/没人信时触发。

say.text: 我要给市场部建一个周报仪表盘,先帮我确定它该回答什么问题。
say.note: Claude会先让你说明决策和受众,再动手拆指标。

say.text: 把营收拆成指标树,并标出哪些是杠杆、哪些是结果。
say.note: 它会给出层层分解的树状结构。

say.text: 诊断一下为什么我们做了数据看板却没人用。
say.note: 它会检查指标可信度、维护、分发等环节。

howto.what_en: Claude will not build a report unless it serves a real decision. Metrics become a tree: one outcome on top, decomposed into drivers. Dashboards need one question per screen, a comparison, a definition of “good” and annotated spikes.
howto.when_en: Activates when you ask to build a dashboard/report or self-serve analytics, design a metrics framework, or diagnose why reporting is unused or untrusted.

say_en.text: Help me figure out what question this marketing dashboard should answer.
say_en.note: It will ask you to name the decision and audience first.

say_en.text: Break revenue into a metric tree and label levers vs outcomes.
say_en.note: It will produce the tree structure.

say_en.text: Diagnose why we have BI dashboards but nobody uses them.
say_en.note: It will check trust, maintenance, and distribution.
